item.title: Self-Hosted Rust Crate Registries Compared: Kellnr vs Alexandrie vs Panamax (2026)
item.description: The Rust ecosystem has exploded in recent years, with developers relying on crates.io as the central registry for open-source libraries. But for enterprises, air-gapped environments, and teams that need private crate hosting, a self-hosted Rust crate registry is essential. Private registries give you control over access, audit trails, offline availability, and custom crate policies that the public registry cannot provide.
